text:
Thomas Township officers report 274 offenses to national crime database in 2024
In 2024, Thomas Township Police Department officers reported a total of 274 offenses, according to the National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS).
This represented an average of fewer than one offense per day during 2024.
Among the crime classifications tracked, simple assault was the most frequently reported, with 60 instances over the year.
The NIBRS offers expanded detail and context for crime data. Under earlier systems, only the most severe offense from a single incident was captured—so if an event included both homicide and lesser offenses such as aggravated assault or theft, just the homicide would appear in crime statistics.
Agencies at local, state and federal levels use NIBRS for their reporting needs.
